column1: # WAREHOUSE ARCHIVE -> OFFICIAL CELESTIA RELEASE ASSET: the byte-equality record.
# Why this file exists. The Celestia archives now come from the effectstream/binaries
# warehouse, but two of the four rows this stack uses are cataloged `legacy-unverified`
# with NULL source and NULL member hashes. Those nulls are truthful and must never be
# back-filled with invented provenance. Instead, equality is proven directly and
# independently against the official celestiaorg release: the warehouse archive's SHA-256
# is byte-for-byte the SHA-256 that celestiaorg publishes for the corresponding asset, in
# both the release-asset API `digest` field and the release's own `checksums.txt`.
# The build reads this file OFFLINE. The previous Dockerfile downloaded each release's
# `checksums.txt` at build time, which made a network resource part of the trust decision
# and let a future release silently change what "verified" meant. These values are pinned.
# `sha256` below is asserted three ways during the build: it must equal the pinned build
# argument for that architecture, and both must equal the hash of the archive actually
# downloaded. A row that is missing, duplicated, or disagreeing fails the build before any
# binary is extracted.
# `source_commit` is `-` for a `legacy-unverified` row ON PURPOSE. The catalog does not
# know it, so neither do we, and the build REJECTS a legacy row that claims one.
# Verified 2026-08-31 against:
#   https://github.com/celestiaorg/celestia-app/releases/tag/v6.4.10   (release id 282480015)
#   https://github.com/celestiaorg/celestia-node/releases/tag/v0.28.4  (release id 265784044)
# CAUTION — look-alike assets. celestia-app v6.4.10 ALSO publishes
# `celestia-app-standalone_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz` and `..._Linux_arm64.tar.gz`, which are
# DIFFERENT artifacts with different checksums. Binding the exact asset name here, and not
# just a checksum, is what keeps one of those from ever satisfying this record.
# columns:
#   warehouse_asset  provenance  official_repo  official_tag  official_asset  official_asset_id  sha256  checksums_sha256  source_commit
